_note: Astellas client registry — governed. v3: entries enriched from bare ids to {id, label, description}. The governed SET is unchanged from v2; on adoption the proposal's id + label are promoted in, the review-only `note` is dropped.

roles.label: ALSAP Approver
roles.description: Approves initial ALSAP content and any updates. Minimum: GSO, Medical Lead, ALSAP Lead.

roles.label: ALSAP Contributing Author
roles.description: Provides functional content to the asset's ALSAP.

roles.label: ALSAP Lead
roles.description: Safety Statistician (QSEG) responsible for development and maintenance of the ALSAP.

roles.label: ALSAP Reviewer
roles.description: Cross-functional reviewer of the draft ALSAP for adequacy and accuracy.

roles.label: Global Safety Officer (GSO)
roles.description: Accountable safety officer for the asset.

roles.label: SAC Chair
roles.description: Leads the Safety Assessment Committee (SAC); typically Global Medical Safety Head or designee, per SOP-AST-28304.

roles.label: Safety Programmer
roles.description: QSEG programmer who develops and/or validates datasets and statistical outputs. Developer vs. Validator is a per-step duty attribute, not a separate role.

roles.label: Safety Management Team (SMT)
roles.description: Cross-functional safety governance body; reviews ALSAP outputs and owns ongoing safety decisions. (A committee, not an individual.)

roles.label: SMT Co-Chair
roles.description: Co-chairs the Safety Management Team; aligns on TLF TOC and shells.
